findings.title: Undefined state/config deref if printProxyError returns
findings.problem: In connectTargets, `state` and `config` are assigned only inside the try block; the catch calls printProxyError (declared `: never`) and execution then falls through to the per-target dispatch (runClaudeDesktop et al.). Definite assignment is guaranteed only by process.exit terminating the process. The edge-case lens independently flags the same catch guard (~:543-554).
findings.impact: If printProxyError ever returns instead of terminating (test stubs that neutralize process.exit, or a future refactor that returns rather than exits), the fall-through dereferences undefined state/config (e.g. `.syncCodeMieUrl`/`.url`), producing a TypeError crash instead of the intended clean error exit.
findings.recommendation: Add an explicit `return` (or `throw`) immediately after printProxyError in the catch, or have printProxyError itself throw, so control can never reach the dispatch with unassigned state/config.

findings.title: Single-target success skips per-target summary block
findings.problem: printSummary is gated on `results.length > 1 || anyFailed`, so a single successful target prints its own `✓ … configured` line but never the 'Targets configured:' summary block. Spec §3.4 calls for printing the per-target summary after all requested targets run; acceptance marks §3.4 partial.
findings.impact: Single-target-success runs deviate from the spec's summary-output requirement. Acceptance confirms no §7 story acceptance criterion is broken and the deviation is cosmetic, but the §3.4 spec requirement is only partially met.
findings.recommendation: Print the per-target summary unconditionally after dispatch (drop the `results.length > 1` gate) so single-target-success also emits the summary block per §3.4.
